skill.name: claude-code-templates
skill.description: Starter templates for creating Claude Code agents, skills, slash commands, and hook scripts.
skill.summary: Create Claude Code extension scaffolds with reusable templates for agents, skills, commands, and hooks.
skill.author: 0xDarkMatter

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by template installation paths, Markdown code formatting, shell hook scaffolding, and documentation links. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, credential access, or malicious persistence intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Static scanners flag installation examples that write to ~/.claude paths.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify in the marketplace listing that these paths are user-controlled Claude Code extension locations, not secret files.

remediation.issue: The hook template logs tool and session identifiers to a local .claude file.
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should review logged fields before enabling the hook in sensitive repositories.

content.value_statement: Creating Claude Code extensions from scratch can lead to missing metadata and unclear structure. This skill provides starter templates for agents, skills, commands, and hooks.
actual_capabilities: Provides an agent template with focus areas, principles, quality checks, and references.
Provides a skill template with frontmatter, usage sections, troubleshooting, and specification notes.
Provides a slash command template with usage, execution flow, options, examples, and output guidance.
Provides a bash hook template with JSON validation, jq parsing, exit code notes, and configuration example.
Shows common naming patterns and file locations for Claude Code extension types.
limitations: Templates contain placeholders that users must replace before use.
The skill does not validate completed extensions automatically.
The hook template requires jq and a shell environment.
Examples are focused on Claude Code, not general IDE extension systems.

use_cases.title: Scaffold a project agent
use_cases.description: Create a structured expert agent with focus areas, quality checks, deliverables, and reference links.
use_cases.target_user: Developers building reusable Claude Code subagents

use_cases.title: Create a reusable skill
use_cases.description: Start a new skill with frontmatter, quick reference tables, usage examples, and troubleshooting sections.
use_cases.target_user: Teams standardizing internal Claude Code workflows

use_cases.title: Draft automation hooks
use_cases.description: Use the hook script template to parse Claude Code hook input and define safe local automation behavior.
use_cases.target_user: Tooling engineers adding guardrails or logging to Claude Code sessions

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic agent template
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new expert persona
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the agent template to create a Python expert agent. Include focus areas for testing, packaging, and performance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a skill scaffold
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for a reusable workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill template to draft a git workflow skill with triggers, quick reference commands, examples, and troubleshooting.

prompt_templates.title: Design a slash command
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the command template to create a review command. Include usage, execution flow, options, examples, and expected output.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a hook template
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the hook script template to draft a PreToolUse hook that validates write paths and explains any blocking behavior.

output_examples.input: Create a new expert agent template for React performance work.
output_examples.output: A filled agent scaffold with a React-focused name, discovery description, focus areas, quality checklist, deliverables, pitfalls, and references.

output_examples.input: Start a new Claude Code skill for release checklist automation.
output_examples.output: A skill scaffold with frontmatter, quick reference tasks, basic usage, common patterns, troubleshooting, and resource sections.

output_examples.input: Draft a hook script template for validating file paths.
output_examples.output: A bash hook scaffold that reads JSON input, validates dependencies, parses fields, documents exit codes, and shows configuration placement.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder before installing a generated template.
Keep skill instructions short and move long references into separate files.
Review hook scripts carefully before enabling them in shared repositories.
anti_patterns: Do not install a template without changing the name and description fields.
Do not add broad tool permissions to a skill unless the workflow requires them.
Do not log sensitive hook input fields unless the repository policy allows it.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It provides templates for Claude Code agents, skills, slash commands, and hook scripts.

faq.question: Does it generate complete production extensions?
faq.answer: No. It creates starting points that users must customize, review, and test.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Codex support, but the templates focus on Claude Code concepts and file locations.

faq.question: Does the hook template run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The template is a bash script scaffold. Users decide whether to install and enable it in Claude Code settings.

faq.question: Why are hidden Claude paths mentioned?
faq.answer: Claude Code stores user extensions under .claude locations, so the templates show those installation paths.

faq.question: What should I check before publishing a generated skill?
faq.answer: Check the frontmatter, trigger description, tool permissions, examples, and any scripts included with the skill.
